case_name: John R. Graham and Nicole Graham v. Commissioner

taxpayer.notes: Claimed EITC for Angela Davis, petitioner wife's sister, age 64 in 2022.

notice_of_deficiency.contested_by_taxpayer: EITC with Angela Davis as qualifying child
conceded: Petitioners conceded at trial that they were not eligible for the EITC for Rayquan Graham

findings_of_fact.fact: Angela Davis is petitioner wife's sister (relationship test met per parties' agreement)
findings_of_fact.snippet: On their tax return they claimed an EITC for Angela Davis, petitioner wife’s sister.

findings_of_fact.fact: Ms. Davis was 64 years old in 2022 and did not file a joint return
findings_of_fact.snippet: In 2022 Ms. Davis was 6 4 years old, and she did not file a joint tax return.

findings_of_fact.fact: Testimony that Ms. Davis lived with petitioners more than six months, but no documentation; residency not established
findings_of_fact.snippet: The record did not include any documentation to support the assertion that Ms. Davis lived with petitioners for more than six months in 2022

findings_of_fact.fact: Permanent and total disability (stroke, wheelchair) asserted by testimony only; not established
findings_of_fact.snippet: or that she was permanently and totally disabled.

issues.question: Are petitioners entitled to the EITC for 2022 with Angela Davis (wife's sister, age 64) as a qualifying child?
issues.holding: No; petitioners did not prove residency for more than half the year or permanent and total disability (needed to satisfy the age test for a 64-year-old)
issues.computable_reason: Turns on lack of documentation for residency and disability (substantiation/burden of proof), although the age test fails mechanically absent disability

decision.text: Decision will be entered for respondent.

notes: Parties agreed relationship and joint-return tests met. Testimony found credible but insufficient without documentation. Age 64 fails §152(c)(3)(A) (under 19 / student under 24) so qualifying-child status depended on §152(c)(3)(B) disability exception. Snippet F2 preserves a PDF spacing artifact ('6 4').
